## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD Normal** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days | Close medical supervision and patient counselling |
| **G6PD Intermediate** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days | Close medical supervision and patient counselling |
| **G6PD Deficient** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Close medical supervision and patient counselling |
| **If no testing availabe** | Based on risk-benefit assessment | Close medical supervision and patient counselling |
